nights.title: Adéla - The Red Bottoms Tour
nights.name: Adéla
nights.extract: Adéla Jergová is a Slovak singer, songwriter, and dancer. After spending her teenage years training as a ballet dancer, she pivoted to making pop music, competing in the talent competition reality show Dream Academy in 2023 and releasing her debut extended play (EP) The Provocateur in 2025. She then supported Demi Lovato on her It's Not That Deep Tour. Her debut studio album Prima and its singles "Ain't in LA" and "Nicole Kidman" all made the UK and US charts, with Prima additionally topping the charts in the Netherlands and Belgium and entering the top ten of several others.
